alerts: Portfolio MER 2.56x is understated — Noura is COD; its revenue settles over 2–3 days. Raghad's clean MER = 4.77x.
Raghad: Meta is ~4× more efficient than TikTok (ROAS 11.3 vs 2.6) but gets only 12% of ad budget — reallocation opportunity.
Raghad: TikTok 'SCALE' campaign CPA 165 (2× the 90 ceiling) + frequency 2.9 fatigue — cap & refresh.

decision.title: Shift budget from TikTok SCALE (CPA 165) toward Meta (ROAS 11, starved at 12% of spend).
decision.detail: Blended MER 4.77x today (above the 4.5 floor) on 1,454 SAR ad spend. But the mix is wrong: TikTok 'SCALE' burns 1,155 SAR at CPA 165 (2× ceiling, freq 2.9 fatigue) returning ROAS ~2.6, while Meta prospecting returns ROAS 11.3 (CPA 35, freq 1.3 fresh) on just 177 SAR. It is a peak day + day-1 of scale, so don't kill SCALE — cap & refresh it and push test budget to Meta where efficiency is ~4× higher. TikTok 'Prospecting Sales' (CPA 41) stays healthy.

decision.title: TikTok efficiency healthy (CPA 75) — but revenue is COD-delayed, hold.
decision.detail: 17 TikTok conversions today at CPA 74.5 (under the 90 ceiling), frequency 1.68, spend 1,267 SAR (+98% vs yesterday). Demand is real (19 orders). But only 40 SAR is settled — COD pays on delivery, so revenue backfills over 2–3 days; do NOT compute ROAS on 40. TikTok drives 78% of attributed sales. Hold budget; re-check in 2 days once COD clears. (Noura runs no Meta.)
